name: LOOK_FOR_BIKES_YELLOW
notes: TMR Queensland TC-series design sheet with a lettered size table (drawing not to scale); every dimension from the table, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing ('CN' / 'CM' / 'DM' read as the plain series). The table's c is the yellow edge and d the edge + black border. TC1775 page 2 supplementary plate LOOK FOR BIKES (under the motorcycle diamond of page 1). Size A generated (a 600 x b 400, c 8 / d 24, e 50, f 80EW, h 30, r 40; B, C also tabled): chain 50 / 80E / 30 / 80E / 30 / 80E / 50 = 400. '80EW' read as Series E (the sheet draws the letters widely spaced; AS 1744 plus0 spacing generated). Black on yellow.
